# `aitbc edge island join`

Join an island with the given ID, name, chain, and role.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc edge island join [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--island-id` | text | — | yes | The Island id. |
| `--island-name` | text | — | yes | The Island name. |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | The Chain id. |
| `--role` | text | `compute-provider` | no | Island role |
| `--is-hub` | flag | `false` | no | Mark as hub node |
| `--confirm` | flag | `false` | no | Confirm the write without prompting |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc edge island join --island-id <island_id> --island-name <island_name> --chain-id <chain_id>
```
